description: Utility class providing static methods for exception handling, including rethrowing specific exception types from an exception chain.

classes.name: ExceptionUtil
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods to analyze and rethrow exceptions or specific causes in a chain.

methods.name: rethrowIfCause
methods.description: Checks if any cause in the exception chain is of a specified type and rethrows that cause as a RuntimeException.

methods.name: rethrowAPIAuthenticationException
methods.description: Checks if the exception chain contains an APIAuthenticationException and rethrows it.
